name: What factors should I consider when choosing a raised toilet?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a raised toilet?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a raised toilet, consider the height that best suits the user's needs, often 17 to 19 inches including the seat. Evaluate bowl shape (round or elongated) based on bathroom size and comfort preference. Consider flushing performance, water efficiency (WaterSense certified models), and aesthetics to match your bathroom design. Features like dual-flush or pressure-assisted flushing might also be important. Our team can help you select the best model for your specific requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider the optimal height, bowl shape, flushing performance, water efficiency, and aesthetics to choose the right raised toilet.
